scope: Continuation queue, not a whole-chapter collation claim. status_rules.pending: Unclaimed work; owner must be null.
status_rules.in_progress: Owner named; current bounded scope and saved report path recorded. Checkpoint before expanding scope.
status_rules.blocked: Set blocker to an object with nonempty reason and next_step, link the saved partial report and evidence, and name the current owner if assigned. Reader uncertainty is not proof that a source is unavailable.
status_rules.done: Completion criteria met; report and evidence linked, canonical dispositions integrated where supported, validation passes, and remote checkpoint verified.
status_rules.unresolved_rule: An unresolved candidate remains blocked with precise evidence and next step; it is not silently counted as resolved. A bounded review report can be finished while the enclosing coverage task stays open.
status_rules.lease_rule: A named owner is a claim, not a permanent lock. At startup check saved reports and remote commits; reclaim a stale claim only after preserving its work and recording the handoff in the report.
status_rules.checkpoint_rule: Commit claim plus first saved report, then each small evidence/decision batch. Only the coordinator publishes; update this queue in the same batch. Remote SHA verification is required before moving on.
status_rules.dependency_rule: depends_on gives preferred review order except at C1-COMPLETION-GATE, where every prerequisite is mandatory. If a preceding task is blocked with a preserved report, the coordinator may select another independently actionable task and update next_task_id; do not mark the blocked task done.

steps: Read the candidate history as a hypothesis. Verify source bytes against the manifest and inspect the full native page before using any crop.

Trace the actual neighboring Tibetan sequence to the named anchor. Record PDF page, provider image, row, source archive member, its SHA-256, and crop bounds. Byte or pixel identity alone does not establish anchor identity.
Save native page context and target evidence; distinguish main letters, shads, tshegs, frames and small source annotations. State exactly what was and was not read.

Inventory every detached mark across a unit boundary before assigning marks to units. Distinguish a glyph-inventory disagreement from editorial terminal/opening ownership, and verify that concatenating adjacent readings neither omits nor duplicates a printed mark.
Record observed reading, existing reading, alternative, disposition, rationale, confidence, uncertainty and independent correspondence review. Expected wording cannot supply a missing glyph.

Integrate only supported decisions into the appropriate authored collation records; preserve rejected proposals and superseded evidence. Build, validate, checkpoint and verify the remote branch before the next batch.
completion_criteria: Every candidate in the batch has a traceable disposition and exact anchor-to-native-image correspondence.
An adopted decision has independent target correspondence review and a canonical intervention or insertion record; a retained or withdrawn proposal has an explicit reason.
Unresolved candidates are blocked with exact glyph or sign bounds and a next step; they do not become agreement.
Reports, evidence, queue, generated edition and validation agree and are preserved in a verified remote checkpoint.

coverage_review.batch_rule: Begin with the task first_batch. Continue in at most five source pages or fewer if reading is difficult; save partial reports immediately. Add exact batch IDs to the report instead of claiming the whole witness complete.
completion_criteria: Every required physical span is accounted for by actual comparison evidence or a precisely bounded source/access limitation; available unread pages remain unfinished.
All supported differences, source layers and unresolved readings have exact anchors, physical locators, evidence and rationale.
Retained earlier ledgers are reused within their actual scopes; superseded claims are identified explicitly.
The coverage ledger and apparatus are updated, the build and validation pass, and reports/evidence are in a verified remote checkpoint.
